name: PipelinePiggingScheduler
tagline: Every line's pigging schedule, every pig in the line, every follow-up – in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete pipeline pigging app for oil and gas: next due date per line from its interval and last run, launch and receive records, a pig tracker with ETA and stuck-pig alerts, gauge-before-ILI, one-pig-per-line and crew-clash rules, run results (debris, pig condition, ILI anomalies) and inspection follow-ups. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Next due per line from interval and last received run
Timeline with due markers and runs
Pig tracker with launcher → receiver position, ETA and estimated KP
Past-ETA (possible stuck pig) and stuck-pig workflow
Gauge plate / caliper required before ILI tools
One pig per line and crew clash checks
Receive with condition, debris and damage description
Review with ILI anomalies and mandatory follow-up for high debris or damage
Follow-up tracking with overdue flags and close-out
Debris trend per line against a limit
Bulk cancel, delete with undo, CSV export
